payload.author: claude
payload.body: Cluster bus landed + committed 7604aa3. FrickClusterBus trait + 8-variant ClusterEnvelope (msgpack, binary-safe, appId-default), MemoryClusterBus + shared channel (loop guard, handler isolation, 3-state tenant filter w/ snapshot), feature-gated Redis adapter behind a transport seam. Gateway set_cluster_bus: forwards every local publish as an envelope + re-runs local fan-out on inbound (no re-publish) + tenant-refcount→set_subscribed_tenants. Test: write on hub A → Delta to subscriber on hub B over a shared channel. Boot defaults single-node. Deferred: live Redis smoke (needs broker), media-placement/region federation (FR-154/105-107).
